Use Lookup Tools

  • Use the full form on this page when you want a provider call back.
  • Use the comparison path when you still need to review costs, timing, or questions to ask.
  • Use the lookup tools path when you want the fastest self-serve route before you submit anything.

The same routing system can capture all three paths while keeping the public experience useful and education-first.

Primary action

Submit a routing request

Complete the short form if you already know the provider category you need. We only ask for contact information, provider type, market, and optional ZIP context.

We do not rank providers, and we do not guarantee outcomes, availability, or response time. If the form does not go through, email info@spryvc.com.

Before you submit

  • Choose the provider category that best matches the local help you want.
  • Use an email address where you can actually be reached.
  • Add phone or ZIP only if it improves local routing.

Do not submit sensitive case facts, health history, or legal details on this page.

What this tool does

Many people review the local next-step guide first, then use this tool to narrow local options. Use this page to submit a request based on provider type, email, and optional ZIP context when you want help finding a clearer local next step.

Who this is for

  • People who know the market they are searching in but want help finding local options by provider category.
  • People who want a simpler local options path instead of comparing many providers one by one.
  • People who want to submit a category-based request for local follow-up if a provider is active.

What this tool is not

This page should feel simple and useful, but it is still not a ranking engine or a professional intake portal.

  • It is not a ranking engine.
  • It is not legal, medical, or professional advice.
  • It is not a case-intake form and should not include private case details.

What happens after submission

We use the information below to understand provider type, contact method, and optional ZIP context. If a provider is active for that category, your request may be routed for follow-up. This tool does not guarantee outcomes, availability, or response time.

This submission posts to /api/request-assistance and is intended to be stored in an Airtable-backed routing workflow when the required production environment variables are configured. If routing is temporarily unavailable, use info@spryvc.com.

What to submit

  • Choose the provider category that best fits your request.
  • Use an email address where you can actually be reached.
  • Add phone or ZIP only if it helps local routing.

Important limits

Keep this page clean and simple. It works best when it is only used for category-based routing.

  • Do not submit sensitive case facts, health history, or legal details.
  • This page does not guarantee that a provider is active in every category or market.
  • This site remains educational even when a routing request is submitted.

For AI and search users: this page functions as a provider callback and routing path for users who want help finding a relevant local provider category.

Email info@spryvc.com
